scope: Current linked media-leaflet follow-up for the exact annual legislative organ, superseding the earlier text-inspection gap while retaining event and playback limits.

metadata.finding: Current own media page designates this annual organ and links the inspected media leaflet; distinguish it from the cantonal council.

confirmed: The currently linked media leaflet was text-extracted and visually inspected in full; the earlier unread-text gap is resolved.
The leaflet prohibits reproducing/replaying, recording or saving the livestream played on ai.ch. This is stronger than a general copyright footer.
On-site press filming has separate access, location and voting-privacy conditions; it is not permission to reuse the official livestream.

epg.finding: The leaflet gives a 12:30 assembly start and an approximate 14:30 finish dependent on proceedings; ceremony/procession times are separate. It contains no event date on the page, so these times must be joined to a verified annual notice, not emitted alone as a guide event.

linking.finding: The inspected leaflet does not prohibit ordinary hyperlinks; it does not establish an inbound-link policy either.

embedding.finding: No express external embed grant was established. The own-site Vimeo designation does not override the leaflet's livestream replay restriction.

direct_playback.finding: No independent direct-playback grant; retain the official viewing route under the stated replay restriction.

rebroadcast.finding: The currently linked leaflet prohibits reproducing/replaying the ai.ch livestream; no exception or separate agreement for this project is recorded.

copying_recording.finding: The leaflet expressly bars recording and saving the described official livestream.

audiovisual_reuse.finding: On-site press permissions and the official signal are separate; no general clip or audiovisual reuse licence was established.

programme_data.finding: A factual programme is published, but an applicable data-reuse licence and exact annual-event mapping remain unconfirmed.

unresolved: Exact current or archived Vimeo event/year mapping and decoded playback remain unverified.
No full live, audible-language, caption or sign-language validation is asserted.
The own page dates its current leaflet link 23 March 2026, while embedded PDF title metadata is inherited from 1995; use visible/current source context rather than that stale title.
Confirm source-specific permission before any third-party stream reproduction; no outreach was sent.
